verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own API docs confirm that multiple views can be created, grouped, sorted and filtered at any level of the hierarchy, which implies several views over the same work. However, no evidence names board, list, calendar or timeline view types, or shows switching between them in the UI. Missing for 10: documentation of board, list, calendar and timeline view types; evidence of switching views over the same task set; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can switch between board, list, calendar, and timeline views of the same work

citations.quote: You can create, update, delete, group, sort, and filter views at any level of the ClickUp hierarchy using the API.
